name: Alex Abbad
bio: Alex Abdullah Abbad (born June 18, 1978) is a two-time Citra winning Indonesian actor and presenter. He was known as an MTV video jockey. His acting career started with Andai Ia Tahu (2002). He won the Piala Citra for My Stupid Boss (2016) and Falling in Love Like in Movies (2023).
